dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there. Judging by your attire, you must be the Traveler, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: Hehe, of course I know you! You're a real celebrity — everyone's heard at least a little about you.

dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: Your friends, Mr. Cyno and Mr. Tighnari, are really famous themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Asenath
dialogues.text: I was just looking for a way to see Desert Foxes more often. They're so cute, I can't help wanting to see them more! If only there was some way to make them less skittish around me, so I could touch their tails and...
